$comment: Ashes Without Number (2025 free edition): the crisis-zone survival procedures NooPunk adopts as its local-scarcity layer. AWN has no verified SRD or open licence (docs/licenses/ISSUE_569_WITHOUT_NUMBER_RIGHTS.md), so this file records the *procedure* — terrain time costs, the privation ladder, foraging, scouting — re-expressed in original NooPunk wording. No source sentence, table heading, hazard list or setting material is reproduced. src/rules/awn_survival.py owns the arithmetic. Nothing here replaces CWN hit points, saves or System Strain: privation feeds System Strain, which CWN already governs.

source.licence: no verified open licence — procedure re-expressed, no text or table copied

terrain.label: Heavy forest, hills, intact urban cores

travel.$terrain_note: A null vehicular column means a ground vehicle cannot cross without a road; with a road it takes 2 hours per hex.

supplies.untreated_water: a disease check each day it is drunk unboiled and unfiltered

privation.$comment: System Strain gained per circumstance. A character already at maximum who gains more must make a Physical save or die by dawn without rescue; a success leaves them helpless.

unit_worth: one day of scavenged food for one person
one day of untreated water for one person in arid ground
one night of firewood for the party
foraging.$difficulty_gap: The source's forage difficulty by terrain was not transcribed. The referee supplies a difficulty and the kernel does not invent one.
